seoTitle: Download the Smartsheet Desktop App (Win & Mac)
metaDescription: Find, download, and install the official Smartsheet Desktop App for Windows or macOS, then sign in and sync your sheets outside the browser.
intro: If you're tired of losing your Smartsheet tabs in a sea of browser windows, the official Desktop App gives you a dedicated, standalone workspace. This guide covers finding the correct installer for your operating system, running the setup wizard, and signing in to sync your sheets.

steps.heading: Go to the official download page
steps.body: Navigate to the Smartsheet website and find the dedicated desktop application download section.

steps.heading: Choose the right installer
steps.body: Select the correct version for your operating system, whether that's the Windows 64-bit installer or the macOS Apple Silicon or Intel build.

steps.heading: Run the installation wizard
steps.body: Download the installer and walk through the standard setup steps to install the app on your machine.

steps.heading: Pin the app for quick access
steps.body: Set up startup preferences and pin the Smartsheet icon to your taskbar or dock.

steps.heading: Sign in and sync
steps.body: Log in via SSO, Google Workspace, or standard credentials to sync your active sheets into the app.

faq.question: Is the Smartsheet Desktop App available for both Windows and Mac?
faq.answer: Yes, there are separate installers for Windows 64-bit and macOS, including Apple Silicon and Intel builds.

faq.question: Can I sign in with Google Workspace credentials?
faq.answer: Yes, the app supports Secure Sign-On, Google Workspace, and standard account credentials.

faq.question: Do my sheets sync between the desktop app and the web version?
faq.answer: Yes, data syncs in real time between the desktop app and the browser-based version.

faq.question: Why use the desktop app instead of the browser?
faq.answer: It provides a dedicated, multi-window layout and a more distraction-free environment for tracking complex workflows.
